findings.demonstration: Rejected generated historical prefix reaches two command stubs before stopping.
findings.finding: Full public historical prefix review occurs only after two new command invocations. Narrow prior packet subset checks do not substitute for the held validator route check.
findings.minimal_repair: Validate supplied current expected packet and complete prior public prefix after validator load, before either new command; retain final full-prefix review.

findings.demonstration: Generated log publication failure skips operation post-state and package post-state in separate tests.
findings.finding: stdout/stderr publication can raise after the child returns but before the post-state block, so post-command checks and execution receipt attempt are skipped.
findings.minimal_repair: Record log-publication error without bypassing post-state and execution-receipt attempts; fail completion if any log cannot be retained.

static_no_other_blocker_scope: No production adapter imports; fixed production command shape and phase budget.
Exact eight-source pins,345 runtime manifest/worktree/index/HEAD checks, clean branch and remote hash, bounded Git calls.
No-follow regular bounded gate files and exact custody-public path allowlist; raw source/capture paths not opened by recorder.
CI four original push jobs, package/strict/source/archive identity and declared artifact delta are checked against root-pinned receipts.
Strict canonical comparisons retain bool-versus-int distinctions on key declared fields; evidence hashes are checked to supplied pins, not regarded as a signature.
Late-close stdout cannot be replaced by success-looking persisted public output; complete negative C exit0 remains scientific blocked.
test_execution_scope: Only extracted function definitions with every external operation stubbed in memory; this establishes the narrow ordering findings, not actual filesystem/network custody.
